theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) [Module.Finite ℤ R] [Module.Free ℤ R] : 1 < Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := v
  have h1 : p ≠ 0 := by contradiction hp
  have h2 : Ideal.isPrime p := Ideal.isPrime_of_is_prime_spectrum hp
  have h3 : Ideal.absNorm p = Ideal.idealAbsNorm p := rfl
  have h4 : Ideal.idealAbsNorm p = Ideal.idealNorm p := by rw [Ideal.idealAbsNorm_eq_idealNorm]
  have h5 : 1 < Ideal.idealNorm p := Ideal.idealNorm_prime_of_isPrime h2
  rw [h3, h4] at h5
  exact h5
